source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
The Defender places first; then players alternate, each placing one unit wholly within their own deployment zone.

- Leave units in **strategic reserves** (chosen during [formation declarations](vsdata:core-rule/chapter-approved.declare-battle-formations)) off the battlefield.
- Deploying a **TITANIC** unit makes you skip your next placement.
- Once you have placed all your units, your opponent sets up any they have left.

detail.afterOneFinishes: other player deploys remaining eligible units
